- Cost delta and estimated savings if we enable prefix/KV caching for the summaries workload (see tab 2).

- Pinebrook-Estimate-20260203.pdf (application/pdf)

If now's not a priority, a quick note on timing is helpful so we don't ping you excessively.

Cheers,
